title.zh: 卷三十八 本紀第三十八: 順帝一
title.raw: 卷三十八 本紀第三十八: 順帝一 Volume 38 Annals 38: Shundi 1

sentences.zh: 順帝一

translations.literal: Shundi 1
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Shundi, Part One

sentences.zh: 順帝名妥歡帖睦爾，明宗之長子。

translations.literal: Emperor Shundi's taboo name was Toghon Temür; he was Mingzong's eldest son.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Shundi, whose taboo name was Toghon Temür, was the eldest son of Emperor Mingzong.

sentences.zh: 母罕祿魯氏，名邁來迪，郡王阿兒廝蘭之裔孫也。

translations.literal: His mother was of the Qarlukh clan, named Mailaiti, a descendant in the line of Prince Arslan.
translations.idiomatic: His mother belonged to the Qarlukh clan and was named Mailaiti, a descendant of Prince Arslan.

sentences.zh: 初，太祖取西北諸國，阿兒廝蘭率其眾來降，乃封為郡王，俾領其部族。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Taizu conquered the states of the northwest, Arslan led his people to submit; he was then enfeoffed as prince of a commandery and made to lead his tribal group.
translations.idiomatic: In the beginning, when Taizu conquered the northwestern states, Arslan led his people in submission and was enfeoffed as a commandery prince to govern his tribe.

sentences.zh: 及明宗北狩，過其地，納罕祿魯氏。

translations.literal: When Mingzong went on his northern campaign and passed through that region, he took the Qarlukh woman.
translations.idiomatic: When Mingzong marched north and passed through that territory, he took a woman of the Qarlukh clan.

sentences.zh: 延祐七年四月丙寅，生帝於北方。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the seventh year of Yanyou, on bingyin day, the Emperor was born in the north.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the seventh year of Yanyou, on the day bingyin, the Emperor was born in the north.

sentences.zh: 三年八月己酉，文宗崩，燕鐵木兒請文宗後立太子燕帖古思，後不從，而命立明宗次子懿璘只班，是為寧宗。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the third year, on jiyou day, Wenzong died. Yan Temür requested that Wenzong's empress install the crown prince Arig Kabak, but the empress did not agree and instead ordered that Mingzong's second son Irinjibal be installed — this was Ningzong.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiyou in the eighth month of the third year, Wenzong died. Yan Temür asked Wenzong's empress to enthrone the crown prince Arig Kabak, but she refused and instead had Mingzong's second son Irinjibal installed as Emperor Ningzong.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬辰，寧宗崩，燕鐵木兒復請立燕帖古思，文宗後曰：「吾子尚幼，妥歡貼睦爾在廣西，今年十三矣，且明宗之長子，禮當立之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on renchen day, Ningzong died. Yan Temür again requested that Arig Kabak be installed. Wenzong's empress said: "My son is still young. Toghon Temür is in Guangxi; he is thirteen this year, and moreover he is Mingzong's eldest son — by ritual he ought to be installed."
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the day renchen, Ningzong died. Yan Temür again pressed for Arig Kabak's enthronement. Wenzong's empress said, "My son is still young. Toghon Temür is in Guangxi; he is thirteen this year, and as Mingzong's eldest son he is the one who should succeed by right."

sentences.zh: 」乃命中書左丞闊裏吉思迎帝於靜江。

translations.literal: " She then ordered the left vice director of the Secretariat, Korghuz, to welcome the Emperor at Jingjiang.
translations.idiomatic: " She then ordered Korghuz, left vice director of the Secretariat, to escort the Emperor from Jingjiang.

sentences.zh: 至良鄉，具鹵簿以迓之。

translations.literal: At Liangxiang, the full imperial guard of honor was prepared to receive him.
translations.idiomatic: At Liangxiang a full imperial escort was prepared to receive him.

sentences.zh: 燕鐵木兒既見帝，並馬徐行，具陳迎立之意。

translations.literal: When Yan Temür had seen the Emperor, they rode side by side at an easy pace, and he fully set forth the intent of welcoming and installing him.
translations.idiomatic: When Yan Temür met the Emperor, they rode abreast at an easy pace while he explained at length why he had come to install him on the throne.

sentences.zh: 帝幼且畏之，一無所答。

translations.literal: The Emperor was young and moreover afraid of him, and answered not a word.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor was still young and afraid of him, and made no reply at all.

sentences.zh: 於是燕鐵木兒疑之，故帝至京，久不得立。

translations.literal: Thereupon Yan Temür became suspicious of him, and so after the Emperor reached the capital he was long unable to be installed.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Temür thereupon grew suspicious of him, and so even after the Emperor reached the capital his enthronement was long delayed.

sentences.zh: 適太史亦言帝不可立，立則天下亂，以故議未決。

translations.literal: Just then the court astronomers also said the Emperor ought not be installed — if installed, the realm would fall into disorder — and for this reason the deliberation was not settled.
translations.idiomatic: At the same time the court astronomers declared that the Emperor should not be enthroned, warning that his installation would throw the realm into chaos, and for this reason the matter remained undecided.

sentences.zh: 遷延者數月，國事皆決於燕鐵木兒，奏文宗後而行之。

translations.literal: The delay lasted several months; state affairs were all decided by Yan Temür, who memorialized Wenzong's empress and then carried them out.
translations.idiomatic: Months passed in delay. State affairs were all decided by Yan Temür, who submitted memorials to Wenzong's empress and then acted on her approval.

sentences.zh: 俄而燕鐵木兒死，後乃與大臣定議立帝，且曰：「萬歲之後，其傳位於燕帖古思，若武宗、仁宗故事。

translations.literal: Before long Yan Temür died. The empress then joined the great ministers in a settled decision to install the Emperor, and moreover said: "After my ten thousand years, the succession shall pass to Arig Kabak, as in the precedent of Wuzong and Renzong."
translations.idiomatic: Before long Yan Temür died. The empress then joined the senior ministers in deciding to enthrone the Emperor, adding, "After my death the throne shall pass to Arig Kabak, following the precedent of Wuzong and Renzong."

sentences.zh: 」諸王宗戚奉上璽綬勸進。

translations.literal: " The princes and imperial kin presented the seal and cord and urged his advance to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: " The princes and imperial kinsmen presented the imperial seal and cord and urged him to ascend the throne.

sentences.zh: 四年六月己巳，帝即位於上都，詔曰：

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the fourth year, on jisi day, the Emperor took the throne at Shangdu and issued an edict saying:
translations.idiomatic: On the day jisi in the sixth month of the fourth year, the Emperor ascended the throne at Shangdu and issued an edict that read:

sentences.zh: 洪惟我太祖皇帝，受命於天，肇造區夏；

translations.literal: Greatly do we consider that our Taizu Emperor received the mandate from Heaven and first created the Middle Kingdom;
translations.idiomatic: Greatly do We reflect that Our Taizu Emperor received Heaven's mandate and first founded the Middle Kingdom;

sentences.zh: 世祖皇帝，奄有四海，治功大備；

translations.literal: Shizu Emperor suddenly possessed the four seas, and his governing achievements were greatly complete;
translations.idiomatic: Shizu Emperor came to hold all within the four seas, and his governing achievements were brought to full completion;

sentences.zh: 列聖相傳，丕承前烈。

translations.literal: the successive sages transmitted the throne, greatly inheriting the former accomplishments.
translations.idiomatic: the successive sage emperors transmitted the throne, greatly inheriting the achievements of those who came before.

sentences.zh: 我皇祖武宗皇帝入纂大統，及致和之季，皇考明宗皇帝遠居朔漠，劄牙篤皇帝戡定內難，讓以天下。

translations.literal: Our imperial ancestor Wuzong Emperor entered to continue the Great Foundation; at the close of the Zhihe era, Our imperial father Mingzong Emperor dwelt far in the northern desert, while Jayaatu Emperor quelled the inner turmoil and yielded the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Our imperial ancestor Emperor Wuzong assumed the Great Foundation; at the close of the Zhihe era Our father Emperor Mingzong dwelt far in the northern steppe, while Emperor Jayaatu quelled the internal strife and yielded the realm.

sentences.zh: 我皇考賓天，劄牙篤皇帝復正宸極。

translations.literal: Our imperial father became a guest of Heaven; Jayaatu Emperor again rectified the imperial pinnacle.
translations.idiomatic: When Our father departed this life, Emperor Jayaatu again restored the imperial throne.

sentences.zh: 治化方隆，奄棄臣庶。

translations.literal: His governing transformation was just rising, when suddenly he abandoned his ministers and people.
translations.idiomatic: His rule was just reaching its height when he suddenly left his ministers and people.

sentences.zh: 今皇太后召大臣燕鐵木兒、伯顏等曰：「昔者闊徹伯、脫脫木兒、只兒哈郎等謀逆，以明宗太子為名，又先為八不沙始以妒忌，妄構誣言，疏離骨肉。

translations.literal: Now the Empress Dowager summoned the great ministers Yan Temür, Bayan, and others, saying: "Formerly Kochebo, Toghtogha, Jir Qalan, and others plotted rebellion under the name of Mingzong's heir; moreover, Budashiri first, out of jealousy, falsely fabricated slanderous words and estranged flesh and bone."
translations.idiomatic: Now the Empress Dowager summoned the senior ministers Yan Temür, Bayan, and others, saying, "Formerly Kochebo, Toghtogha, Jir Qalan, and others plotted rebellion in the name of Mingzong's heir; and Budashiri, moved by jealousy, had earlier fabricated false charges to drive a wedge between close kin."

sentences.zh: 逆臣等既正其罪，太子遂遷於外。

translations.literal: After the rebellious ministers had been punished for their crimes, the heir was then moved to the outer regions.
translations.idiomatic: Once the traitors had been punished, the heir was sent away to the provinces.

sentences.zh: 劄牙篤皇帝後知其妄。

translations.literal: Jayaatu Emperor afterward knew this was false.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Jayaatu later learned that this was false.

sentences.zh: 尋至大漸，顧命有曰：『朕之大位，其以朕兄子繼之。

translations.literal: Soon he reached his final illness, and in his parting charge said: 'My great throne — let my elder brother's son succeed to it.'
translations.idiomatic: Soon he fell gravely ill and left a deathbed command: 'Let my elder brother's son succeed to the great throne.'

sentences.zh: 』」時以朕遠征南服，以朕弟懿璘只班登大位，以安百姓，乃遽至大故。

translations.literal: '" At that time, because We were on distant campaign in the southern domains, Our younger brother Irinjibal ascended the great throne to settle the people — yet he suddenly met with great death.
translations.idiomatic: '" Because We were then on campaign in the south, Our younger brother Irinjibal was enthroned to reassure the people, but he too suddenly died."

sentences.zh: 皇太后體承劄牙篤皇帝遺意，以武宗皇帝之元孫，明宗皇帝之世嫡，以賢以長，在予一人，遣使迎還。

translations.literal: The Empress Dowager, embodying Jayaatu Emperor's dying intent, considering that We are Wuzong Emperor's eldest grandson and Mingzong Emperor's legitimate heir by descent, worthy and senior — residing in Us alone — dispatched envoys to welcome Us back.
translations.idiomatic: The Empress Dowager, honoring Emperor Jayaatu's dying wish, recognized that We are Wuzong's eldest grandson and Mingzong's legitimate heir — worthy and senior, residing in Us alone — and dispatched envoys to bring Us back.

sentences.zh: 征集宗室諸王來會，合辭推戴。

translations.literal: She summoned the princes of the imperial clan to assemble; with united words they urged Our installation.
translations.idiomatic: She summoned the princes of the imperial clan to assemble, and with one voice they urged Our enthronement.

sentences.zh: 今奉皇太后勉進之篤，宗親大臣懇請之至，以至順四年六月初八日，即皇帝位於上都。

translations.literal: Now, following the Empress Dowager's earnest urging to advance, and the utmost earnest request of imperial kin and great ministers, on the eighth day of the sixth month of the fourth year of Zhishun We have taken the imperial throne at Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: Now, yielding to the Empress Dowager's earnest urging and the impassioned pleas of the imperial kin and senior ministers, on the eighth day of the sixth month of the fourth year of Zhishun We have ascended the imperial throne at Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 於戲！

translations.literal: Alas!
translations.idiomatic: Alas!

sentences.zh: 惟天、惟祖宗全付予有家，栗栗危懼，若涉淵冰，罔知攸濟。

translations.literal: Heaven and the ancestors have wholly entrusted the realm to Us; trembling in perilous fear, as if treading deep water and thin ice, We know not how to cross.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven and the ancestors have wholly entrusted the realm to Us; trembling with fear, as if walking over deep water and thin ice, We know not how We shall succeed.

sentences.zh: 尚賴宗親臣鄰，交修不逮，以底隆平。

translations.literal: We still rely on imperial kin, ministers, and neighbors to jointly repair Our shortcomings, so as to reach peaceful prosperity.
translations.idiomatic: We still rely on the imperial kin, Our ministers, and Our allies to help Us remedy Our failings and bring the realm to lasting peace.

sentences.zh: 其赦天下。

translations.literal: Let there be an amnesty throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Let there be a general amnesty throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 時有阿魯輝帖木兒者，明宗親臣也，言於帝曰：「天下事重，宜委宰相決之，庶可責其成功；

translations.literal: At that time there was one Aruq Temür, a close minister of Mingzong, who said to the Emperor: "The affairs of the realm are weighty; they ought to be entrusted to the chief ministers for decision, so that one may hold them responsible for success;"
translations.idiomatic: At that time a certain Aruq Temür, a close minister of Mingzong, said to the Emperor, "The affairs of the realm are weighty and ought to be left to the chief ministers to decide, so that they may be held accountable for results;"

sentences.zh: 若躬自聽斷，則必負惡名。

translations.literal: "if you personally hear and decide cases, you will surely bear an ill reputation."
translations.idiomatic: "if Your Majesty personally hears and decides every matter, you will surely earn a bad name."

sentences.zh: 」帝信之，由是深居宮中，每事無所專焉。

translations.literal: " The Emperor believed this; from this he dwelt deep within the palace and took charge of nothing in particular.
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor believed him and thereafter kept to the inner palace, taking personal charge of nothing.

sentences.zh: 辛未，命伯顏為太師、中書右丞相、上柱國、監修國史，兼奎章閣大學士，領學士院、太史院、回回、漢人司天監事；

translations.literal: On xinwei day, Bayan was appointed Grand Preceptor, right chancellor of the Secretariat, supreme pillar of state, supervisor of the compilation of the national history, and concurrently grand academician of the Kuizhang Pavilion, directing the Hanlin Academy, the Astronomical Bureau, and the Muslim and Han astronomical directorates;
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinwei, Bayan was appointed Grand Preceptor, right chancellor of the Secretariat, supreme pillar of state, and supervisor of the national history, while also serving as grand academician of the Kuizhang Pavilion and directing the Hanlin Academy, the Astronomical Bureau, and the Muslim and Han astronomical directorates;

sentences.zh: 撒敦為太傅、左丞相。

translations.literal: Satu was appointed Grand Tutor and left chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: Satu was appointed Grand Tutor and left chancellor.

sentences.zh: 是月，大霖雨，京畿水平地丈餘，饑民四十餘萬，詔以鈔四萬錠賑之。

translations.literal: That month there was great continuous rain; in the capital region the water on level ground was more than a zhang deep. More than four hundred thousand famine victims — an edict ordered relief with forty thousand ingots of paper money.
translations.idiomatic: That month torrential rains flooded the capital region to more than a zhang on level ground. More than four hundred thousand people faced famine, and an edict ordered relief with forty thousand ingots of paper money.

sentences.zh: 涇河溢，關中水災。

translations.literal: The Jing River overflowed; there was flooding in Guanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: The Jing River burst its banks, and Guanzhong suffered flooding.

sentences.zh: 黃河大溢，河南水災。

translations.literal: The Yellow River greatly overflowed; there was flooding in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow River flooded severely, bringing disaster to Henan.

sentences.zh: 兩淮旱，民大饑。

translations.literal: The two Huai regions suffered drought; the people were in great famine.
translations.idiomatic: Drought struck the two Huai regions, and the people suffered severe famine.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，霖雨。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, there was continuous rain.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn there was continuous rain.

sentences.zh: 潮州路水。

translations.literal: Chaozhou circuit had flooding.
translations.idiomatic: Chaozhou circuit was flooded.

sentences.zh: 己亥，太陰犯房宿。

translations.literal: On jihai day, the moon crossed the lodge Fang.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jihai, the moon transited the lodge Fang.

sentences.zh: 八月壬申，鞏昌徽州山崩。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on renshen day, mountains collapsed in Gongchang and Huizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the day renshen, mountains collapsed in Gongchang and Huizhou.

sentences.zh: 是月，立燕鐵木兒女伯牙吾氏為皇后。

translations.literal: That month, Yan Temür's daughter of the Bayiju clan was installed as empress.
translations.idiomatic: That month Yan Temür's daughter of the Bayiju clan was installed as empress.

sentences.zh: 九月甲午，太陰犯填星。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on jiawu day, the moon crossed Saturn.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the day jiawu, the moon transited Saturn.

sentences.zh: 乙未，太陰犯天江。

translations.literal: On yiwei day, the moon crossed Tianjiang.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yiwei, the moon transited Tianjiang.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，中書省臣言：「官員遞升，窒礙選法。

translations.literal: On jiayin day, Secretariat officials said: "Officials advancing by successive promotion obstruct the selection law."
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiayin, Secretariat officials reported, "Successive promotion of officials obstructs the selection regulations."

sentences.zh: 今請自省、院、臺官外，其餘不許遞升。

translations.literal: "Now we request that apart from officials of the Secretariat, the Censorate, and the various courts, the rest not be permitted successive promotion."
translations.idiomatic: "We now request that, apart from officials of the Secretariat, the Censorate, and the various courts, no others be permitted successive promotion."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，太陰犯填星。

translations.literal: On dingsi day, the moon crossed Saturn.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingsi, the moon transited Saturn.

sentences.zh: 己未，太陰犯氐宿。

translations.literal: On jiwei day, the moon crossed the lodge Di.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiwei, the moon transited the lodge Di.

sentences.zh: 庚申，詔太師、右丞相伯顏，太傅、左丞相撒敦，專理國家大事，其餘官不得兼領三職。

translations.literal: On gengshen day, an edict ordered that Grand Preceptor and right chancellor Bayan and Grand Tutor and left chancellor Satu exclusively manage the great affairs of state; other officials might not concurrently hold three offices.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengshen, an edict directed Grand Preceptor and right chancellor Bayan and Grand Tutor and left chancellor Satu to manage the great affairs of state exclusively, and forbade other officials from concurrently holding three offices.

sentences.zh: 秦州山崩。

translations.literal: Mountains collapsed in Qinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Mountains collapsed in Qinzhou.

sentences.zh: 賑恤寧夏饑民五萬三千人一月。

translations.literal: Relief was given to fifty-three thousand famine victims in Ningxia for one month.
translations.idiomatic: Fifty-three thousand famine victims in Ningxia were given relief for one month.

sentences.zh: 詔免儒人役。

translations.literal: An edict exempted scholars from corvée labor.
translations.idiomatic: An edict exempted scholars from corvée labor.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲子，太陰犯斗宿。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on jiazi day, the moon crossed the lodge Dou.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the day jiazi, the moon transited the lodge Dou.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，鳳州山崩。

translations.literal: On bingyin day, mountains collapsed in Fengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingyin, mountains collapsed in Fengzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，改元，詔曰：「在昔世祖皇帝，紹開丕圖，稽古建元，立經陳紀，列聖相承，恪遵成憲。

translations.literal: On wuchen day, the era name was changed; an edict said: "In the past Shizu Emperor continued and opened the great design, examined antiquity to establish the era name, set forth the classics and displayed the regulations; successive sages transmitted the throne, reverently following the established statutes."
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuchen the era name was changed. An edict read, "In the past Emperor Shizu continued the great design, looked to antiquity to establish era names, and set forth institutions and regulations; the successive sage emperors transmitted the throne, reverently following the established statutes."

sentences.zh: 肆予沖人，嗣大歷服，茲圖治之雲初，嘉與民而更始。

translations.literal: "Now We, a young person, have succeeded to the great calendar and robes; this is but the cloud's beginning of Our plan to govern — We gladly join with the people in making a new start."
translations.idiomatic: "Now We, still young, have succeeded to the great foundation; at this first dawn of Our governance We gladly join the people in making a fresh start."

sentences.zh: 乃新紀號，誕告多方，其以至順四年為元統元年。

translations.literal: "We therefore renew the era designation and broadly announce it to the many regions: let the fourth year of Zhishun be the first year of Yuantong."
translations.idiomatic: "We therefore establish a new era name and proclaim it throughout the realm: the fourth year of Zhishun shall be the first year of Yuantong."

sentences.zh: 於戲！

translations.literal: Alas!
translations.idiomatic: Alas!

sentences.zh: 一元運於四時，惟裁成之有道；

translations.literal: The one origin operates through the four seasons — only by cutting and completing is there the Way;
translations.idiomatic: The one origin moves through the four seasons — only through proper shaping and completion is there the Way;

sentences.zh: 大統綿於萬世，思保佑於無疆。

translations.literal: the great foundation extends through ten thousand generations — We think of blessing without boundary.
translations.idiomatic: the great foundation extends through ten thousand generations — We pray for boundless blessing.

sentences.zh: 」中書省臣言：「凡朝賀遇雨，請便服行禮。

translations.literal: " Secretariat officials said: "Whenever court congratulations encounter rain, we request that informal dress be worn to perform the rites."
translations.idiomatic: " Secretariat officials reported, "Whenever court congratulations are held in rain, we request that informal dress be permitted for the rites."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 己巳，加知樞密院事、答剌罕答裏金紫光祿大夫。

translations.literal: On jisi day, Darqan Dari, associate manager of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was promoted to Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with golden seal and purple robe.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jisi, Darqan Dari, associate manager of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was promoted to Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with golden seal and purple robe.

sentences.zh: 庚午，詔以察罕腦兒宣慰司人民，止令應當徽政院差發。

translations.literal: On gengwu day, an edict ordered that the people of the Chaghan Nao'er Pacification Commission respond only to labor requisitions from the Bureau of Palace Provisions.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengwu, an edict directed that the people of the Chaghan Nao'er Pacification Commission answer only to labor requisitions from the Bureau of Palace Provisions.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，雲南亻嵬羅土官渾鄧馬弄來貢方物，詔以其地升立散府。

translations.literal: On guiyou day, the native official Hun Dengmanong of the Wailuo tribe in Yunnan came to offer tribute goods; an edict ordered that his territory be elevated and a loose-administration prefecture established.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guiyou, the native official Hun Dengmanong of the Wailuo tribe in Yunnan presented tribute; an edict ordered his territory elevated to a loose-administration prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，依皇太后行年之數，釋放罪囚二十七人。

translations.idiomatic: On the day dingchou, in accordance with the Empress Dowager's age, twenty-seven prisoners were released.

translations.idiomatic: On the day gengchen, the imperial portraits of Emperor Wenzong and the Grand Empress Dowager were installed at the Great Chengtian Protecting Sage Temple, and left chancellor Satu was appointed superintendent of auspicious rites to conduct their sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，詔以高郵府為伯顏食邑。

translations.idiomatic: On the day yiyou, an edict made Gaoyou Prefecture Bayan's sustenance fief.

sentences.zh: 戊子，封撒敦為榮王，食邑廬州。

translations.idiomatic: Tangqishi inherited his father's title as Prince of Taiping and was promoted to Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with golden seal and purple robe.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，中書省臣請集議武宗、英宗、明宗三朝皇后升祔。

translations.idiomatic: On the day gengyin, Secretariat officials requested a collective deliberation on elevating the empresses of the Wuzong, Yingzong, and Mingzong reigns to joint enshrinement.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛卯朔，罷富州金課。

translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the eleventh month, xinmao, the gold tax at Fuzhou was abolished.

sentences.zh: 甲午，太陰犯壘壁陣。

translations.literal: On jiawu day, the moon crossed Leibi formation.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiawu, the moon transited the Leibi formation.

sentences.zh: 丙申，鞏昌成紀縣地裂山崩，令有司賑被災人民。

translations.idiomatic: On the day bingshen, the ground split and mountains collapsed in Chengji County, Gongchang; the responsible offices were ordered to relieve the afflicted population.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，享於太廟。

translations.idiomatic: On the day dingyou, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，起棕毛殿。

translations.literal: On xinchou day, construction began on the Palm-Fiber Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinchou, construction began on the Palm-Fiber Hall.

sentences.zh: 丙午，申飭鹽運司。

translations.idiomatic: On the day bingwu, the Salt Transport Directorate was admonished and rectified.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，江西、湖廣、江浙、河南復立榷茶運司。

translations.literal: On xinhai day, the Tea Monopoly Transport Directorates in Jiangxi, Huguang, Jiangzhe, and Henan were re-established.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinhai, the Tea Monopoly Transport Directorates in Jiangxi, Huguang, Jiangzhe, and Henan were re-established.

sentences.zh: 追謚劄牙篤皇帝為聖明元孝皇帝，廟號文宗。

translations.idiomatic: Emperor Jayaatu was posthumously titled Emperor Shengming Yuanxiao, with the temple name Wenzong.

translations.idiomatic: As the resting temple had not yet been built, a temporary colored hall was erected at Yingzong's shrine position to install the spirit tablets.

translations.idiomatic: Bayan was enfeoffed as Prince of Qin and granted a golden seal.

translations.idiomatic: That same day mountains collapsed and the ground split open in Qinzhou.

translations.idiomatic: On the day renzi, the moon transited Saturn.

translations.idiomatic: On the day yimao, the five hundred qing of fields Yan Temür had been granted at Pingjiang were granted again to his son Tangqishi.

translations.idiomatic: The General Directorate of Artisans of All Categories at the Great Repaying-Kindness Temple in Hejian was abolished.

translations.idiomatic: Jiangzhe suffered drought and famine; charity-granary grain was distributed and wealthy households were urged to contribute grain for relief.

translations.idiomatic: An edict directed Prince of Qin and right chancellor Bayan and Prince Rong and left chancellor Satu to command all offices and oversee civil government.

translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the day gengshen, Bayan was ordered to take charge of the Zhangde Weiwu Guard.

translations.idiomatic: Nulienita succeeded his father Talaqi as darughachi of the Tamna Military-Civilian Pacification Commission and was granted a three-pearl tiger tally.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，太陰犯鬼宿。

translations.literal: On guiyou day, the moon crossed the lodge Gui.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guiyou, the moon transited the lodge Gui.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，禿堅帖木兒致仕，錫太尉印，置僚屬。

translations.idiomatic: On the day jiaxu, Tuq Temür retired and was granted the seal of Grand Commandant, with a staff appointed for him.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，為皇太后置徽政院，設官屬三百六十有六員。

translations.literal: On yihai day, a Bureau of Palace Provisions was established for the Empress Dowager, with three hundred sixty-six officials appointed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yihai, a Bureau of Palace Provisions was established for the Empress Dowager with three hundred sixty-six officials.

sentences.zh: 太白犯壘壁陣，太陰犯軒轅。

translations.literal: Venus crossed Leibi formation; the moon crossed Xuanyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Venus transited the Leibi formation; the moon transited Xuanyuan.

sentences.zh: 己卯，太陰犯進賢。

translations.literal: On jimao day, the moon crossed Jinxian.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jimao, the moon transited Jinxian.

sentences.zh: 癸未，太陰犯東咸。

translations.literal: On guiwei day, the moon crossed Dongxian.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guiwei, the moon transited Dongxian.

sentences.zh: 元統二年春正月庚寅朔，雨血於汴梁，著衣皆赤。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the second year of Yuantong, on the first day gengyin, blood rained at Bianliang, staining clothing red.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the first month of spring in the second year of Yuantong, the day gengyin, blood rained at Bianliang and stained clothing red.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，東平須城縣、濟寧濟州、曹州濟陰縣水災，民饑，詔以鈔六萬錠賑之。

translations.literal: On xinmao day, floods struck Xucheng County in Dongping, Jizhou in Jining, and Jiyin County in Caozhou; the people faced famine, and an edict ordered relief with sixty thousand ingots of paper money.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinmao, floods struck Xucheng County in Dongping, Jizhou in Jining, and Jiyin County in Caozhou. The people faced famine, and an edict ordered relief with sixty thousand ingots of paper money.

sentences.zh: 以御史大夫脫別臺為中書平章政事，阿裏海牙為河南行省左丞相。

translations.idiomatic: Censor-in-chief Tobedai was appointed associate director of the Secretariat, and Aliqaya was appointed left chancellor of the Henan Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，享於太廟。

translations.literal: On dingyou day, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingyou, offerings were presented at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，四川大盤洞蠻謀谷什用遣男謀者什用來貢方物，即其地立盤順府，命謀谷什用為知府。

translations.literal: On wuxu day, the great Pan Cave Miao of Sichuan, Mogushiyong, sent his son Moguzheshiyong to offer tribute goods; a Pan Shun Prefecture was established on his territory and Mogushiyong was appointed prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuxu, Mogushiyong of the great Pan Cave Miao in Sichuan sent his son Moguzheshiyong to present tribute; a Pan Shun Prefecture was established on his territory and Mogushiyong was appointed prefect.

sentences.zh: 遣吏部尚書帖住、禮部郎中智熙善使交趾，以《授時曆》賜之。

translations.literal: Minister of Personnel Tiezhu and director of rites Zhixi Shan were dispatched as envoys to Annam, presenting the Shoushi Calendar as a gift.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Personnel Tiezhu and director of rites Zhixi Shan were dispatched as envoys to Annam, presenting the Shoushi Calendar as a gift.

sentences.zh: 太陰犯軒轅。

translations.literal: The moon crossed Xuanyuan.
translations.idiomatic: The moon transited Xuanyuan.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，敕僧道與民一體充役。

translations.literal: On guimao day, an edict ordered that monks and Daoists perform corvée labor on the same basis as commoners.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guimao, an edict ordered that monks and Daoists perform corvée labor on the same basis as commoners.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以上文宗皇帝謚號，遣官告祭於南郊。

translations.literal: On jiyou day, in accordance with Wenzong Emperor's posthumous title, officials were dispatched to announce sacrifices at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiyou, in accordance with Emperor Wenzong's posthumous title, officials were dispatched to announce sacrifices at the southern suburb.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，太陰犯房宿。

translations.literal: On gengxu day, the moon crossed the lodge Fang.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengxu, the moon transited the lodge Fang.

translations.literal: On jiayin day, the General Directorate of Broad Teaching was abolished and a Branch Commission for the Regulation of Buddhist Affairs was established.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiayin, the General Directorate of Broad Teaching was abolished and a Branch Commission for the Regulation of Buddhist Affairs was established.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，雲南土酋姚安路總管高明來獻方物，錫符印遣之。

translations.literal: On yimao day, the native chieftain Gao Ming, route commander of Yao'an in Yunnan, came to present tribute goods and was granted seals and credentials before being sent home.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yimao, the native chieftain Gao Ming, route commander of Yao'an in Yunnan, came to present tribute and was granted seals and credentials before being sent home.

sentences.zh: 二月己未朔，詔內外興舉學校。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the first day jiwei, an edict ordered schools to be established inside and outside the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the second month, jiwei, an edict ordered schools to be established throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，廣西徭寇邊，殺官吏。

translations.literal: On guihai day, Yao bandits in Guangxi raided the frontier and killed officials.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guihai, Yao bandits in Guangxi raided the frontier and killed officials.

sentences.zh: 廣海官已除而未上者罪之。

translations.literal: Guangdong and maritime officials who had been appointed but had not reported for duty were punished.
translations.idiomatic: Guangdong and maritime officials who had been appointed but had not reported for duty were punished.

sentences.zh: 甲子，塞北東涼亭雹，民饑，詔上都留守發倉廩賑之。

translations.literal: On jiazi day, hail fell at Dongliangting in the northern frontier; the people faced famine, and an edict ordered the Shangdu garrison commander to open granaries for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiazi, hail fell at Dongliangting in the northern frontier. The people faced famine, and an edict ordered the Shangdu garrison commander to open granaries for relief.

translations.literal: On yichou day, the responsible offices were ordered to supply winter clothing to the palace guards on schedule.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yichou, the responsible offices were ordered to supply winter clothing to the palace guards on schedule.

sentences.zh: 以燕不鄰為太保，置僚屬。

translations.literal: Yanbulin was appointed Grand Guardian and given a staff.
translations.idiomatic: Yanbulin was appointed Grand Guardian and given a staff.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，封也真也不幹為昌寧王，錫金印。

translations.literal: On wuchen day, Yazhenyebugan was enfeoffed as Prince of Changning and granted a golden seal.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuchen, Yazhenyebugan was enfeoffed as Prince of Changning and granted a golden seal.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，太陰犯太微上相。

translations.literal: On guiyou day, the moon crossed the Upper Minister star of Taiwei.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guiyou, the moon transited the Upper Minister star of Taiwei.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，封皇姑妥妥輝為英壽大長公主。

translations.literal: On dingchou day, the Emperor's paternal aunt Totoqei was enfeoffed as Grand Princess of Yingshou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingchou, the Emperor's paternal aunt Totoqei was enfeoffed as Grand Princess of Yingshou.

sentences.zh: 癸未，安豐路旱饑，敕有司賑糶麥萬六千七百石。

translations.idiomatic: On the day guiwei, Anfeng Circuit suffered drought and famine; the responsible offices were ordered to sell sixteen thousand seven hundred shi of relief grain.

sentences.zh: 甲申，太廟木陛壞，遣官告祭。

translations.idiomatic: On the day jiashen, the wooden steps of the Imperial Ancestral Temple collapsed; officials were dispatched to announce sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，太白經天。

translations.literal: On dinghai day, Venus crossed the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dinghai, Venus crossed the sky.

translations.idiomatic: That month the Luan and Qi rivers overflowed; Yongping and other counties suffered flooding, and five thousand ingots of paper money were granted for relief.

translations.idiomatic: Ruizhou Circuit was flooded; ten thousand shi of rice were granted for relief.

translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the third month, jichou, an edict read, "Civil-service examinations, Imperial Academy credits, student stipends, and scholar exemptions from corvée shall all follow the old statutes of successive reigns;"

translations.literal: The moon crossed Saturn.
translations.idiomatic: The moon transited Saturn.

translations.literal: The Frontier Patrol Grand Marshal's Office in the Western Regions was re-established.

translations.idiomatic: The Directorate of Broad Righteousness was abolished and the Directorate of Verification was re-established.

sentences.zh: 贈吉烈思官，令其子孫襲職。

translations.literal: Jiresi was granted an official title posthumously, and his descendants were permitted to inherit his office.
translations.idiomatic: Jiresi was granted an official title posthumously, and his descendants were permitted to inherit his office.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.idiomatic: On the day dingsi, an edict declared, "Mongols and semu who commit adultery, theft, or fraud shall be placed under the Court of the Imperial Clan;"

sentences.zh: 漢人、南人犯者，屬有司。

translations.literal: Han Chinese and southern subjects who commit such crimes shall belong to the regular offices.
translations.idiomatic: Han Chinese and southern subjects who commit such crimes shall be handled by the regular offices.

sentences.zh: 」是月，山東霖雨，水湧，民饑，賑糶米二萬二千石。

translations.idiomatic: That month Shandong suffered continuous rain and rising waters; the people faced famine, and twenty-two thousand shi of relief grain were sold.

sentences.zh: 淮西饑，賑糶米二萬石。

translations.literal: Huaixi faced famine; twenty thousand shi of relief grain were sold.
translations.idiomatic: Huaixi faced famine; twenty thousand shi of relief grain were sold.

sentences.zh: 湖廣旱，自是月不雨至於八月。

translations.literal: Huguang suffered drought; from this month no rain fell until the eighth month.
translations.idiomatic: Huguang suffered drought; from this month no rain fell until the eighth month.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊午朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the first day wuwu, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the fourth month of summer, wuwu, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 庚申，封宗室蠻子為文濟王。

translations.literal: On gengshen day, the imperial clansman Manzi was enfeoffed as Prince of Wenji.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengshen, the imperial clansman Manzi was enfeoffed as Prince of Wenji.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，命順元等處軍民宣撫使、八番等處沿邊宣慰使伯顏溥花承襲父職。

translations.literal: On yichou day, Bayan Buqa, military-civilian pacification commissioner of Shunyuan and other regions and frontier pacification commissioner of the Eight Divisions and other regions, was ordered to inherit his father's post.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yichou, Bayan Buqa, military-civilian pacification commissioner of Shunyuan and other regions and frontier pacification commissioner of the Eight Divisions and other regions, was ordered to inherit his father's post.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，罷龍慶州黑峪道上勝火兒站。

translations.literal: On bingyin day, the Sheng Huo'er courier station on the Heiyu Road in Longqing Prefecture was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingyin, the Sheng Huo'er courier station on the Heiyu Road in Longqing Prefecture was abolished.

sentences.zh: 庚午，詔：「雲南出征軍士亡歿者，人賜鈔二錠以葬。

translations.literal: On gengwu day, an edict said: "For soldiers of the Yunnan expedition who died in service, two ingots of paper money per man shall be granted for burial."
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengwu, an edict declared, "For soldiers of the Yunnan expedition who died in service, two ingots of paper money per man shall be granted for burial."

sentences.zh: 」壬申，命唐其勢為總管高麗女直漢軍萬戶府達魯花赤，與馬劄兒臺並為御史大夫。

translations.literal: " On renshen day, Tangqishi was appointed darughachi of the General Command of Goryeo, Jurchen, and Han Troops and concurrently censor-in-chief with Maqaritai.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renshen, Tangqishi was appointed darughachi of the General Command of Goryeo, Jurchen, and Han Troops and concurrently censor-in-chief with Maqaritai.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，太白經天。

translations.literal: On dingchou day, Venus crossed the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingchou, Venus crossed the sky.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On wuyin day, Venus was visible in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuyin, Venus was visible in daylight.

translations.idiomatic: On the day jimao, the spirit tablet of Emperor Wenzong Shengming Yuanxiao was installed in joint enshrinement at the Imperial Ancestral Temple; the Emperor personally performed the announcement sacrifice with palace music and the threefold offering rite.

sentences.zh: 先是，御史臺臣言：「郊廟，國之大典，王者必行親祀之禮，所以盡尊尊、親親之誠，宜因升祔，有事於太廟。

It is fitting that, on the occasion of joint enshrinement, rites be performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple."

sentences.zh: 」帝從之。

translations.literal: The Emperor approved this.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 是日，罷夏季時享。

translations.literal: That day the summer seasonal offering was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: That day the summer seasonal offering was suspended.

sentences.zh: 詔加榮王、左丞相撒敦開府儀同三司、上柱國、錄軍國重事，食邑廬州。

translations.literal: An edict advanced Prince Rong and left chancellor Satu to Commissioner with the Protocol Equal to the Three Dukes, supreme pillar of state, and recorder of weighty state affairs, with Luzhou as his sustenance fief.
translations.idiomatic: An edict advanced Prince Rong and left chancellor Satu to Commissioner with the Protocol Equal to the Three Dukes, supreme pillar of state, and recorder of weighty state affairs, with Luzhou as his sustenance fief.

sentences.zh: 復立杭州四隅錄事司。

translations.literal: The Four-Corner Record Offices of Hangzhou were re-established.
translations.idiomatic: The Four-Corner Record Offices of Hangzhou were re-established.

sentences.zh: 太白晝見。

translations.literal: Venus was visible in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: Venus was visible in daylight.

translations.literal: On renwu day, it appeared again.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renwu, it appeared again.

translations.literal: The Emperor commended Xu Heng for assisting Shizu in not killing a single person under Heaven and specially enrolled his grandson Congzong as director of the Bi Zhen Treasury in the Imperial Pendant Office.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor commended Xu Heng for assisting Shizu in sparing the realm from slaughter and specially enrolled his grandson Congzong as director of the Bi Zhen Treasury in the Imperial Pendant Office.

translations.literal: On guiwei day, salt bureaus were established in the northern and southern wards of the capital; the government sold salt directly to reform the abuse of monopoly profits.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guiwei, salt bureaus were established in the northern and southern wards of the capital; the government sold salt directly to reform the abuse of monopoly profits.

translations.literal: On yiyou day, Secretariat officials said: "Buddhist almsgiving and expenditures are excessively great; compared with Shizu's time, each year has increased by thirty-eight ingots of gold, two hundred three ingots and forty liang of silver, more than sixty-one thousand six hundred bolts of silk and brocade, and more than twenty-nine thousand two hundred fifty ingots of paper money."
translations.idiomatic: On the day yiyou, Secretariat officials reported, "Buddhist almsgiving and expenditures have grown excessively; compared with Shizu's time, each year has increased by thirty-eight ingots of gold, two hundred three ingots and forty liang of silver, more than sixty-one thousand six hundred bolts of silk and brocade, and more than twenty-nine thousand two hundred fifty ingots of paper money."

sentences.zh: 請除累朝期年忌日之外，餘皆罷。

translations.literal: "Apart from the annual memorial days of successive reigns, let the rest be abolished."
translations.idiomatic: "Apart from the annual memorial days of successive reigns, let the rest be abolished."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

translations.literal: " That month the imperial carriage made its seasonal tour to Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: That month the imperial carriage made its seasonal tour to Shangdu.

translations.literal: Yidu and Dongping circuits suffered flooding; a prohibition on wine was imposed.
translations.idiomatic: Yidu and Dongping circuits suffered flooding; a prohibition on wine was imposed.

translations.literal: Daming Circuit suffered disaster to mulberry and wheat.
translations.idiomatic: Daming Circuit suffered disaster to mulberry and wheat.

translations.idiomatic: Chengzhou suffered drought and famine; an edict ordered treasury paper money distributed and grain from the ever-normal granary released for relief.

sentences.zh: 河南旱，自是月不雨至於八月。

translations.literal: Henan suffered drought; from this month no rain fell until the eighth month.
translations.idiomatic: Henan suffered drought; from this month no rain fell until the eighth month.

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day jichou, an edict ordered that Iriljiq, son of Prince Weiwu of Xining Aqaba, inherit his father's enfeoffment.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the day jichou, an edict ordered that Iriljiq, son of Prince Weiwu of Xining Aqaba, inherit his father's enfeoffment.

translations.idiomatic: The eunuch Boluo Temür, transmitting the empress's command, took one hundred thousand ingots of salt into the Central Governance Bureau.

translations.literal: On xinmao day, Tangqishi was appointed left chancellor of the Secretariat in Satu's place; Satu remained to deliberate on Secretariat affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinmao, Tangqishi was appointed left chancellor of the Secretariat in Satu's place; Satu remained to deliberate on Secretariat affairs.

translations.literal: On renchen day, associate director Sadi was ordered to direct the Mongol Imperial Academy.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renchen, associate director Sadi was ordered to direct the Mongol Imperial Academy.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，罷洪教提點所。

translations.literal: On guisi day, the Hongjiao Directorate was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guisi, the Hongjiao Directorate was abolished.

translations.literal: On wushen day, an edict ordered Prince of Wenji Manzi to garrison Daming and Prince of Yunnan Aru to garrison Yunnan, granting silver-character round plaques.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wushen, an edict ordered Prince of Wenji Manzi to garrison Daming and Prince of Yunnan Aru to garrison Yunnan, granting silver-character round plaques.

sentences.zh: 是月，中書省臣言：「江浙大饑，以戶計者五十九萬五百六十四，請發米六萬七百石、鈔二千八百錠，及募富人出粟，發常平、義倉賑之，並存海運糧七十八萬三百七十石以備不虞。

translations.literal: That month Secretariat officials said: "Jiangzhe has suffered great famine; by household count there are five hundred ninety thousand five hundred sixty-four; we request the distribution of sixty thousand seven hundred shi of rice, two thousand eight hundred ingots of paper money, recruitment of the wealthy to contribute grain, and release of ever-normal and charity granaries for relief, while retaining seven hundred eighty thousand three hundred seventy shi of sea-transport grain in reserve against emergencies."
translations.idiomatic: That month Secretariat officials reported, "Jiangzhe has suffered great famine affecting five hundred ninety thousand five hundred sixty-four households; we request sixty thousand seven hundred shi of rice, two thousand eight hundred ingots of paper money, recruitment of wealthy households to contribute grain, release of ever-normal and charity granaries for relief, and retention of seven hundred eighty thousand three hundred seventy shi of sea-transport grain in reserve."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

translations.idiomatic: An edict declared, "Princes, imperial kin, military stations, artisans, falconers, and crane handlers registered only with metropolitan counties shall perform corvée on the same basis wherever they are located."

sentences.zh: 」贈故中書平章政事王泰亨謚清憲。

translations.idiomatic: Wang Taiheng, former associate director of the Secretariat, was posthumously granted the title Qingxian.

translations.literal: The old statute provided that officials of third rank and above who displayed great integrity at court or rendered great merit and achievement to the royal house might be granted a merit title and posthumous name.
translations.idiomatic: The old statute provided that officials of third rank and above who displayed great integrity at court or rendered great merit to the royal house might be granted a merit title and posthumous name.

translations.idiomatic: By then the practice had grown lax; only Taiheng, while in the Secretariat, when Annam requested Buddhist scriptures asked that the Nine Classics be granted instead, and as envoy to Goryeo refused gifts — yet as minister was too poor to support himself — was therefore specially granted this posthumous title.

translations.idiomatic: Kan Wenxing, manager of Zhangzhou Ten-thousand Households Office, was posthumously granted Marquis of Heroic Resolve; his wife Lady Wang was granted Lady of Steadfast Virtue; their temple was named Shuangjie.

translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the sixth month, dingsi, Secretariat officials reported, "In Dali, Zhongqing, and other circuits of Yunnan, rebellions by Tuojian and Baihu left the people destitute; with disasters added, famine has struck; we request one hundred thousand ingots of paper money and officials for relief."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

translations.literal: " On wuwu day, the Huai River rose; at Manpu, Qinggang, and other places in Shanyang County, Huaian Circuit, many people, livestock, and houses were drowned.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuwu, the Huai River rose; at Manpu, Qinggang, and other places in Shanyang County, Huaian Circuit, many people, livestock, and houses were drowned.

translations.idiomatic: On the day bingyin, Xuande Prefecture suffered flooding; two thousand ingots of paper money were issued for relief.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，唐其勢辭左丞相不拜，復命撒敦為左丞相。

translations.idiomatic: On the day xinsi, an edict ordered Mongols and Semu to observe mourning for their parents.

translations.idiomatic: On the day guimou, the Weaving Artisans Bureau was re-established to manufacture silks and brocades.

translations.idiomatic: On the day yiyou, Yan Temür was posthumously granted the merit title Meritorious Minister of Public Loyalty, State-Opening, Grand Broad Design, Shared Virtue, Assisting the Fortune, and Aiding Mandate, along with the ranks of Commissioner with the Protocol Equal to the Three Dukes, Grand Preceptor, and right chancellor of the Secretariat; he was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of De with the posthumous title Zhongwu.

translations.idiomatic: That month white fluff rained at Zhangde.

translations.idiomatic: The autumn seasonal offerings were abolished.

translations.literal: The relevant offices were ordered to manufacture the jade register and jade seal of the Grand Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 乞依舊制，裁減冗濫，廣仁愛之心，省糜費之患。

translations.idiomatic: On the day bingwu, an edict ordered the lands of Wusa and Wumeng placed under the Sichuan Branch Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 是月，耒陽、常寧、道州民饑，以米萬六千石並常平米賑糶之。

translations.literal: That month, the people of Leiyang, Changning, and Daozhou suffered famine; sixteen thousand shi of rice and Changping relief grain were issued for sale and relief.
translations.idiomatic: That month the people of Leiyang, Changning, and Daozhou suffered famine; sixteen thousand shi of rice and Changping relief grain were issued for sale and relief.

sentences.zh: 車駕還自上都。

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲寅，熒惑犯南斗。

translations.literal: On the first day of the tenth month, jiayin, Mars transgressed Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the tenth month, jiayin, Mars transgressed Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以大司農塔失海牙為太尉，置僚屬，商議中書省事。

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以塔失帖木兒為太禧院使，議軍國重事；

translations.literal: On dingsi day, Tash Temür was appointed director of the Grand Blessings Court to deliberate on weighty military and state affairs;
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingsi, Tash Temür was appointed director of the Grand Blessings Court to deliberate on weighty military and state affairs;

sentences.zh: 流晃火帖木兒、答裏、唐其勢子孫於邊地。

translations.literal: Huanghuo Temür, Dari, and the descendants of Tangqishi were exiled to the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: Huanghuo Temür, Dari, and the descendants of Tangqishi were exiled to the frontier.

sentences.zh: 詔海道都漕運萬戶府船戶與民一體充役。

translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered ship households of the Maritime Transport General Commission to perform corvée labor on the same terms as commoners.

translations.idiomatic: On the day renxu, Censor-in-Chief Temür Buqa was promoted to Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with silver seal and blue robe.

translations.literal: On guihai day, Censor-in-Chief Wanze Temür was exiled to Guanghai for resettlement.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guihai, Censor-in-Chief Wanze Temür was exiled to Guanghai for resettlement.

sentences.zh: 完者帖木兒乃賊臣也先鐵木兒骨肉之親，監察御史以為言，故斥之。

translations.literal: Wanze Temür was a close kinsman of the traitor Yesun Temür; supervising censors reported this, and so he was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Wanze Temür was a close kinsman of the traitor Yesun Temür; supervising censors reported this, and so he was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 選省、院、臺、宗正府通練刑獄之官，分行各道，與廉訪司審決天下囚。

translations.idiomatic: Officials of the Secretariat, Privy Council, Censorate, and Court of the Imperial Clan versed in criminal law were selected and dispatched to each circuit to decide cases of prisoners throughout the realm together with the surveillance commissions.

sentences.zh: 甲子，太陰犯昴宿。

translations.idiomatic: On the day dingmao, the moon transgressed the Dipper asterism.

translations.idiomatic: On the day wuchen, Venus was visible in daylight.

sentences.zh: 以宗王亦思幹兒弟撒昔襲其兄封。

translations.idiomatic: Prince Yisigan's younger brother Saxi inherited his elder brother's enfeoffment.

sentences.zh: 監察御史呂思誠等十九人劾奏徹裏帖木兒之罪，不聽，皆辭去，惟陳允文以不署名留。

translations.idiomatic: Supervising censors Lü Sicheng and eighteen others memorialized impeaching Cher Temür; the memorial was not heard, and all resigned — only Chen Yunwen remained, having not signed.

sentences.zh: 辛未，太皇太后玉冊、玉寶成，遣官告祭於太廟。

translations.literal: On xinwei day, the jade register and jade seal of the Grand Empress Dowager were completed; officials were dispatched to announce sacrifices at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinwei, the jade register and jade seal of the Grand Empress Dowager were completed; officials were dispatched to announce sacrifices at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 是月，以伯顏獨任中書右丞相詔天下。

translations.literal: That month, an edict was issued throughout the realm that Bayan alone held the right chancellorship of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: That month an edict was issued throughout the realm that Bayan alone held the right chancellorship of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚辰，敕以所在儒學貢士莊田租給宿衛衣糧，詔罷科舉。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on gengchen day, an order directed that rents from the tribute-scholar estate lands of local Confucian schools supply clothing and grain for palace guards, and an edict abolished the civil service examinations.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the day gengchen, an order directed that rents from the tribute-scholar estate lands of local Confucian schools supply clothing and grain for palace guards, and an edict abolished the civil service examinations.

sentences.zh: 甲申，太白經天。

translations.literal: On jiashen day, Venus crossed the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiashen, Venus crossed the sky.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，伯顏請內外官悉循資銓註，今後毋得保舉，澀滯選法，從之。

translations.literal: On yiyou day, Bayan requested that all inner and outer officials be appointed strictly by seniority and quota, with no further recommendations permitted hereafter, to end the stagnation of the selection system — this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yiyou, Bayan requested that all inner and outer officials be appointed strictly by seniority and quota, with no further recommendations permitted hereafter, to end the stagnation of the selection system — this was approved.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，命知樞密院事馬劄兒臺領武備寺。

translations.literal: On guisi day, Maqaritai, associate manager of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was ordered to direct the Armaments Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guisi, Maqaritai, associate manager of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was ordered to direct the Armaments Temple.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，太白經天。

translations.literal: On bingxu day, Venus crossed the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingxu, Venus crossed the sky.

sentences.zh: 己丑，辰星犯房宿。

translations.literal: On jichou day, Mercury transgressed the Room asterism.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jichou, Mercury transgressed the Room asterism.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以燕鐵木兒、唐其勢、答裏所奪高麗田宅，還其王阿剌忒納失裏。

translations.literal: On jiawu day, the fields and houses in Goryeo seized by Yan Temür, Tangqishi, and Dari were returned to King Aradnashiri.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiawu, the fields and houses in Goryeo seized by Yan Temür, Tangqishi, and Dari were returned to King Aradnashiri.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以戶部尚書徐奭、吏部尚書定住參議中書省事。

translations.literal: On dingyou day, Xu Yi, minister of revenue, and Dingzhu, minister of personnel, were appointed to deliberate on Secretariat affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingyou, Xu Yi, minister of revenue, and Dingzhu, minister of personnel, were appointed to deliberate on Secretariat affairs.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，召前知樞密院事福丁、失剌不花、撒兒的哥還京師。

translations.literal: On wuxu day, the former associate manager of the Bureau of Military Affairs Fuding, Shila Buqa, and Sadiqa were recalled to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuxu, the former associate manager of the Bureau of Military Affairs Fuding, Shila Buqa, and Sadiqa were recalled to the capital.

sentences.zh: 初，二人以帝未立，謀誅燕鐵木兒，為所誣貶，故正之。

translations.literal: Earlier, the two men, because the Emperor had not yet been installed, had plotted to execute Yan Temür and were slandered and demoted by him — hence they were now rehabilitated.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, the two men, because the Emperor had not yet been installed, had plotted to execute Yan Temür and were slandered and demoted by him — hence they were now rehabilitated.

sentences.zh: 己亥，太陰犯太微垣。

translations.literal: On jihai day, the moon transgressed the Taiwei Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jihai, the moon transgressed the Taiwei Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 庚子，太陰犯左執法。

translations.literal: On gengzi day, the moon transgressed the Left Executor of Law.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengzi, the moon transgressed the Left Executor of Law.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，下詔改元，詔曰：

translations.literal: On xinchou day, an edict changing the reign title was issued; the edict said:
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinchou, an edict changing the reign title was issued; the edict said:

sentences.zh: 朕祗紹天明，入纂丕緒，於今三年，夙夜寅畏，罔敢怠荒。

translations.literal: We reverently received Heaven's mandate and entered to inherit the great succession; for three years now We have been vigilant from dawn till dusk and have not dared to be idle or negligent.
translations.idiomatic: We reverently received Heaven's mandate and entered to inherit the great succession; for three years now We have been vigilant from dawn till dusk and have not dared to be idle or negligent.

sentences.zh: 茲者年谷順成，海宇清謐，朕方增修厥德，日以敬天恤民為務，屬太史上言，星文示儆。

translations.literal: Now the year's grain ripened in season and the realm was tranquil; We were just then improving Our virtue and taking reverence for Heaven and care for the people as Our daily task, when the court astronomer reported that the stars showed a warning.
translations.idiomatic: Now the year's grain ripened in season and the realm was tranquil; We were just then improving Our virtue and taking reverence for Heaven and care for the people as Our daily task, when the court astronomer reported that the stars showed a warning.

sentences.zh: 將朕德菲薄，有所未逮歟？

translations.literal: Is it that Our virtue is thin and something has not been achieved?
translations.idiomatic: Is it that Our virtue is insufficient and something has been left undone?

sentences.zh: 天心仁愛，俾予以治，有所告戒歟？

translations.literal: Is Heaven's heart benevolent, enabling Us to govern, and offering some admonition?
translations.idiomatic: Is Heaven's heart benevolent, enabling Us to govern, and offering some admonition?

sentences.zh: 弭災有道，善政為先。

translations.literal: There is a way to quell calamity — good government comes first.
translations.idiomatic: There is a way to quell calamity — good government comes first.

sentences.zh: 更號紀年，實惟舊典。

translations.literal: Changing era names and counting years is indeed the ancient precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Changing era names and counting years is indeed the ancient precedent.

sentences.zh: 惟世祖皇帝在位長久，天人協和，諸福咸至，祖述之志，良切朕懷。

translations.literal: Only Emperor Shizu reigned long, Heaven and humanity were in harmony, and every blessing arrived — the aspiration to follow his example is truly close to Our heart.
translations.idiomatic: Only Emperor Shizu reigned long, Heaven and humanity were in harmony, and every blessing arrived — the aspiration to follow his example is truly close to Our heart.

sentences.zh: 今特改元統三年仍為至元元年。

translations.literal: Now We specially change the third year of Yuantong back to the first year of Zhiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Now We specially change the third year of Yuantong back to the first year of Zhiyuan.

sentences.zh: 遹遵成憲，誕布寬條，庶格禎祥，永綏景祚。

translations.literal: Far following the established statutes, We broadly promulgate lenient measures, hoping to draw down auspicious signs and forever secure the throne's fortune.
translations.idiomatic: Far following the established statutes, We broadly promulgate lenient measures, hoping to draw down auspicious signs and forever secure the throne's fortune.

sentences.zh: 赦天下。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was declared throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was declared throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 立常平倉。

translations.literal: Ever-Normal Granaries were established.
translations.idiomatic: Ever-Normal Granaries were established.

translations.idiomatic: On the day dingwei, Cher Temür, associate manager of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was granted a three-pearl tiger tally.

translations.idiomatic: The Grain Supply Office was placed under the Bureau of Transmission.

sentences.zh: 加知樞密院事闊裏吉思銀青榮祿大夫，兼左翊蒙古侍衛親軍都指揮使。

translations.idiomatic: Korlas, associate manager of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was promoted to Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with silver seal and blue robe and concurrently commander-in-chief of the Left Wing Mongol Palace Guard.

translations.idiomatic: On the day renzi, the moon transgressed Encampment.

translations.literal: On yimao day, the Yunnan Branch Secretariat was ordered to compile new and old registers of soldiers' pay and grain.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yimao, the Yunnan Branch Secretariat was ordered to compile new and old registers of soldiers' pay and grain.

translations.idiomatic: On the day bingchen, the expenses for food and drink of princes, princesses, and imperial sons-in-law were reduced.

sentences.zh: 詔征高麗王阿剌忒納失裏入朝。

translations.literal: An edict ordered King Aradnashiri of Goryeo to come to court.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered King Aradnashiri of Goryeo to come to court.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，詔伯顏領宮相府。

translations.literal: On dingsi day, an edict ordered Bayan to direct the Palace and Chancellor's Office.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingsi, an edict ordered Bayan to direct the Palace and Chancellor's Office.

sentences.zh: 戊午，日赤如赭。

translations.literal: On wuwu day, the sun was red like cinnabar.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuwu, the sun was red like cinnabar.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，太白犯壘壁陣。

translations.literal: On xinyou day, Venus transgressed Encampment.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinyou, Venus transgressed Encampment.

translations.idiomatic: On the day renxu, one hundred qing of pasture land in Luzhou and Raozhou were allocated and granted to Prince of Xuannrang Temür Buqa.

translations.idiomatic: The Sichuan, Yunnan, and Jiangxi branch secretariats were ordered to nominate and select tribal officials to await regular appointment.

sentences.zh: 」命宣政使末吉以司徒就第。

translations.literal: " Mojie, commissioner of Buddhist affairs, was ordered to take the rank of Minister of Education and retire to his residence.
translations.idiomatic: Mojie, commissioner of Buddhist affairs, was ordered to take the rank of Minister of Education and retire to his residence.

translations.idiomatic: Venus transgressed the Lady Star of Xuanyuan.

translations.literal: At night, the moon transgressed the Right Executor of Law.
translations.idiomatic: At night the moon transgressed the Right Executor of Law.

sentences.zh: 庚午，太白經天，壬申，復如之。

translations.idiomatic: On the day gengwu, Venus crossed the sky; on the day renshen, it did so again.

translations.idiomatic: On the day guiyou, Jupiter was visible in daylight.

translations.literal: On yihai day, Venus and Jupiter were both visible in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yihai, Venus and Jupiter were both visible in daylight.

translations.literal: On bingzi day, Anqing, Qi, and Huang suffered earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingzi, Anqing, Qi, and Huang suffered earthquake.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，西番賊起，遣兵擊之。

translations.literal: On dingchou day, bandits rose in the Western Regions; troops were dispatched to strike them.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingchou, bandits rose in the Western Regions; troops were dispatched to strike them.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，蒙古國子監成。

translations.literal: On wuyin day, the Mongol Imperial Academy was completed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuyin, the Mongol Imperial Academy was completed.

sentences.zh: 是日，太白經天，歲星晝見。

translations.literal: That day, Venus crossed the sky and Jupiter was visible in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: That day Venus crossed the sky and Jupiter was visible in daylight.

translations.literal: That month, Baoxing Circuit suffered famine; three thousand shi of rice were issued for sale and relief.
translations.idiomatic: That month Baoxing Circuit suffered famine; three thousand shi of rice were issued for sale and relief.

translations.literal: On dinghai day, the sun was red like cinnabar for three days in all.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dinghai, the sun was red like cinnabar for three days in all.

sentences.zh: 戊子，復以宗正府為大宗正府。

translations.literal: On wuzi day, the Court of the Imperial Clan was restored as the Grand Court of the Imperial Clan.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuzi, the Court of the Imperial Clan was restored as the Grand Court of the Imperial Clan.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，詔宗室脫脫木兒襲封荊王，賜金印，命掌忙來諸軍，設立王府官屬。

translations.literal: On renchen day, an edict ordered the imperial clansman Toqtoq Temür to inherit the enfeoffment as Prince of Jing, granted a golden seal, and ordered to command the Manglai armies and establish princely household officials.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renchen, an edict ordered the imperial clansman Toqtoq Temür to inherit the enfeoffment as Prince of Jing, granted a golden seal, and ordered to command the Manglai armies and establish princely household officials.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，御史大夫撒的加銀青榮祿大夫，領奎章閣，知經筵事。

translations.literal: On dingyou day, Censor-in-Chief Sadi was promoted to Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with silver seal and blue robe, placed in charge of the Kuizhang Pavilion, and appointed to direct the Classics Colloquium.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingyou, Censor-in-Chief Sadi was promoted to Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with silver seal and blue robe, placed in charge of the Kuizhang Pavilion, and appointed to direct the Classics Colloquium.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，御史臺臣復劾奏中書平章政事徹裏帖木兒罪，罷之。

translations.literal: On wuxu day, censorate officials again memorialized impeaching associate administrator Cher Temür; he was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuxu, censorate officials again memorialized impeaching associate administrator Cher Temür; he was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 庚子，太陰犯心星。

translations.literal: On gengzi day, the moon transgressed the Heart star.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengzi, the moon transgressed the Heart star.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，流徹裏帖木兒於南安。

translations.literal: On renyin day, Cher Temür was exiled to Nan'an.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renyin, Cher Temür was exiled to Nan'an.

sentences.zh: 太陰犯箕宿。

translations.literal: The moon transgressed the Winnowing-Basket asterism.
translations.idiomatic: The moon transgressed the Winnowing-Basket asterism.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，太陰犯南斗。

translations.literal: On guimao day, the moon transgressed Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guimao, the moon transgressed Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 丙午，詔平章政事塔失海牙領都水、度支二監。

translations.idiomatic: On the day bingwu, an edict ordered associate administrator Tash Kay to direct the Directorates of Waterways and Revenue.

sentences.zh: 是年，江西大水，民饑，賑糶米七萬七千石。

translations.literal: That year, Jiangxi suffered great flood; the people suffered famine, and seventy-seven thousand shi of rice were issued for sale and relief.
translations.idiomatic: That year Jiangxi suffered great flood; the people suffered famine, and seventy-seven thousand shi of rice were issued for sale and relief.

sentences.zh: 賜天下田租之半。

translations.literal: Half of the land tax throughout the realm was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Half of the land tax throughout the realm was remitted.

sentences.zh: 凡有妻室之僧，令還俗為民，既而復聽為僧。

translations.literal: All monks who had wives were ordered to return to lay life as commoners, but afterward they were again permitted to become monks.
translations.idiomatic: All monks who had wives were ordered to return to lay life as commoners, but afterward they were again permitted to become monks.

sentences.zh: 移犍為縣還舊治。
